sanskrit: janamejaya uvāca prāpya rājyaṃ mahābhāgāḥ pāṇḍavā me pitāmahāḥ katham āsan mahārāje dhṛtarāṣṭre mahātmani
english: Janamejaya said: When my illustrious grandsires the Pāṇḍavas had won the kingdom, how did they conduct themselves toward the great-souled king Dhṛtarāṣṭra?

sanskrit: sa hi rājā hatāmātyo hataputro nirāśrayaḥ katham āsīd dhataiśvaryo gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī
english: That king, his counsellors slain, his sons slain, left without support and stripped of sovereignty—how did he fare, and how the renowned Gāndhārī?

sanskrit: kiyantaṃ caiva kālaṃ te pitaro mama pūrvakāḥ sthitā rājye mahātmānas tan me vyākhyātum arhasi
english: And for how long did those great-souled forefathers of mine remain in possession of the kingdom? This you ought to expound to me.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca prāpya rājyaṃ mahātmānaḥ pāṇḍavā hataśatravaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ puraskṛtya pṛthivīṃ paryapālayan
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Having won the kingdom, their foes slain, the great-souled Pāṇḍavas governed the earth, keeping Dhṛtarāṣṭra at their head.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭram upātiṣṭhad viduraḥ saṃjayas tathā yuyutsuś cāpi medhāvī vaiśyāputraḥ sa kauravaḥ
english: Upon Dhṛtarāṣṭra waited Vidura and Saṃjaya, and the wise Yuyutsu too, that Kaurava born of a vaiśya woman.

sanskrit: pāṇḍavāḥ sarvakāryāṇi saṃpṛcchanti sma taṃ nṛpam cakrus tenābhyanujñātā varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca
english: In all affairs the Pāṇḍavas consulted that king, and with his sanction they carried them out for fifteen years.

sanskrit: sadā hi gatvā te vīrāḥ paryupāsanta taṃ nṛpam pādābhivandanaṃ kṛtvā dharmarājamate sthitāḥ te mūrdhni samupāghrātāḥ sarvakāryāṇi cakrire
english: Daily those heroes would go and attend upon that king, doing homage at his feet and abiding by the Dharma-king's will; and when he had kissed their heads, they went about all their tasks.

sanskrit: kuntibhojasutā caiva gāndhārīm anvavartata draupadī ca subhadrā ca yāś cānyāḥ pāṇḍavastriyaḥ samāṃ vṛttim avartanta tayoḥ śvaśrvor yathāvidhi
english: Kuntī, daughter of Kuntibhoja, deferred to Gāndhārī; and Draupadī and Subhadrā and the other wives of the Pāṇḍavas behaved with equal devotion toward both mothers-in-law, as was due.

sanskrit: śayanāni mahārhāṇi vāsāṃsy ābharaṇāni ca rājārhāṇi ca sarvāṇi bhakṣyabhojyāny anekaśaḥ yudhiṣṭhiro mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭre 'bhyupāharat
english: Costly couches, garments, and ornaments, and all things befitting a king, and foods and dainties in great abundance—all these, O great king, Yudhiṣṭhira presented to Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: tathaiva kuntī gāndhāryāṃ guruvṛttim avartata viduraḥ saṃjayaś caiva yuyutsuś caiva kauravaḥ upāsate sma taṃ vṛddhaṃ hataputraṃ janādhipam
english: Likewise Kuntī behaved toward Gāndhārī as toward an elder; and Vidura, Saṃjaya, and Yuyutsu the Kaurava waited upon that aged lord of men whose sons were slain.

sanskrit: syālo droṇasya yaś caiko dayito brāhmaṇo mahān sa ca tasmin maheṣvāsaḥ kṛpaḥ samabhavat tadā
english: And Droṇa's brother-in-law, that one beloved and mighty brāhmaṇa, the great archer Kṛpa, was likewise at his side then.

sanskrit: vyāsaś ca bhagavān nityaṃ vāsaṃ cakre nṛpeṇa ha kathāḥ kurvan purāṇarṣir devarṣinṛparakṣasām
english: And the blessed Vyāsa, that sage of old, ever dwelt with the king, telling tales of gods, divine seers, kings, and rākṣasas.

sanskrit: dharmayuktāni kāryāṇi vyavahārānvitāni ca dhṛtarāṣṭrābhyanujñāto viduras tāny akārayat
english: Matters in accord with dharma and bound up with civil dealings, Vidura, sanctioned by Dhṛtarāṣṭra, caused to be carried out.

sanskrit: sāmantebhyaḥ priyāṇy asya kāryāṇi sugurūṇy api prāpyante 'rthaiḥ sulaghubhiḥ prabhāvād vidurasya vai
english: Even weighty favors sought of him by the neighboring chiefs were obtained at trifling cost, through the influence of Vidura.

sanskrit: akarod bandhamokṣāṃś ca vadhyānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ tathā na ca dharmātmajo rājā kadā cit kiṃ cid abravīt
english: He effected releases of prisoners and the freeing of those condemned to death, and the king, son of Dharma, never said anything against it.

sanskrit: vihārayātrāsu punaḥ kururājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sarvān kāmān mahātejāḥ pradadāv ambikāsute
english: And on outings and excursions the Kuru king Yudhiṣṭhira of great splendor granted every desire to the son of Ambikā.

sanskrit: ārālikāḥ sūpakārā rāgakhāṇḍavikās tathā upātiṣṭhanta rājānaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ yathā purā
english: Cooks, broth-makers, and confectioners of sweets waited upon king Dhṛtarāṣṭra as in former days.

sanskrit: vāsāṃsi ca mahārhāṇi mālyāni vividhāni ca upājahrur yathānyāyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya pāṇḍavāḥ
english: And costly garments and garlands of many kinds the Pāṇḍavas duly brought to Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: maireyaṃ madhu māṃsāni pānakāni laghūni ca citrān bhakṣyavikārāṃś ca cakrur asya yathā purā
english: Maireya liquor, mead, meats, and light beverages, and varied preparations of dainties, they made for him as before.

sanskrit: ye cāpi pṛthivīpālāḥ samājagmuḥ samantataḥ upātiṣṭhanta te sarve kauravendraṃ yathā purā
english: And those guardians of the earth who came together from all quarters all waited upon the Kaurava lord as in former days.

sanskrit: kuntī ca draupadī caiva sātvatī caiva bhāminī ulūpī nāgakanyā ca devī citrāṅgadā tathā
english: And Kuntī and Draupadī, and the lovely Sātvatī woman, and Ulūpī the serpent-maiden, and the lady Citrāṅgadā as well—

sanskrit: dhṛṣṭaketoś ca bhaginī jarāsaṃdhasya cātmajā kiṃkarāḥ smopatiṣṭhanti sarvāḥ subalajāṃ tathā
english: and the sister of Dhṛṣṭaketu, and the daughter of Jarāsaṃdha—all of these waited like handmaids upon the daughter of Subala.

sanskrit: yathā putraviyukto 'yaṃ na kiṃ cid duḥkham āpnuyāt iti rājānvaśād bhrātṝn nityam eva yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: "Bereft of his sons though he is, let him suffer no grief whatever"—thus did Yudhiṣṭhira ever instruct his brothers, the king commanding them.

sanskrit: evaṃ te dharmarājasya śrutvā vacanam arthavat saviśeṣam avartanta bhīmam ekaṃ vinā tadā
english: And so, having heard the weighty word of the Dharma-king, they conducted themselves with special care—all save Bhīma alone.

sanskrit: na hi tat tasya vīrasya hṛdayād apasarpati dhṛtarāṣṭrasya durbuddher yad vṛttaṃ dyūtakāritam
english: For that which had been wrought through the dicing by evil-minded Dhṛtarāṣṭra never slipped from the heart of that hero.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evaṃ saṃpūjito rājā pāṇḍavair ambikāsutaḥ vijahāra yathāpūrvam ṛṣibhiḥ paryupāsitaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Thus honored by the Pāṇḍavas, the king, son of Ambikā, disported himself as of old, attended by sages.

sanskrit: brahmadeyāgrahārāṃś ca pradadau sa kurūdvahaḥ tac ca kuntīsuto rājā sarvam evānvamodata
english: And that scion of the Kurus made grants of land in gift to brāhmaṇas, and the king, son of Kuntī, approved of it all.

sanskrit: ānṛśaṃsyaparo rājā prīyamāṇo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ uvāca sa tadā bhrātṝn amātyāṃś ca mahīpatiḥ
english: King Yudhiṣṭhira, devoted to gentleness and full of affection, then spoke thus to his brothers and his counsellors, that lord of the earth:

sanskrit: mayā caiva bhavadbhiś ca mānya eṣa narādhipaḥ nideśe dhṛtarāṣṭrasya yaḥ sthāsyati sa me suhṛt viparītaś ca me śatrur nirasyaś ca bhaven naraḥ
english: "By me and by you this lord of men is to be honored. Whoever abides by Dhṛtarāṣṭra's command is my friend; the man who acts contrary is my foe, and shall be cast out."

sanskrit: paridṛṣṭeṣu cāhaḥsu putrāṇāṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi dadātu rājā sarveṣāṃ yāvad asya cikīrṣitam
english: "And on the appointed days, in the funeral rites for his sons, let the king bestow upon all whatever he is minded to give."

sanskrit: tataḥ sa rājā kauravyo dhṛtarāṣṭro mahāmanāḥ brāhmaṇebhyo mahārhebhyo dadau vittāny anekaśaḥ
english: Then that great-minded Kaurava king Dhṛtarāṣṭra gave riches without stint to brāhmaṇas worthy of high honor.

sanskrit: dharmarājaś ca bhīmaś ca savyasācī yamāv api tat sarvam anvavartanta dhṛtarāṣṭravyapekṣayā
english: And the Dharma-king, and Bhīma, and Savyasācin, and the twins too, all followed in this out of regard for Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: kathaṃ nu rājā vṛddhaḥ san putraśokasamāhataḥ śokam asmatkṛtaṃ prāpya na mriyeteti cintyate
english: "How may the aged king, smitten with grief for his sons, not perish from any sorrow brought upon him by us?"—thus did they take thought.

sanskrit: yāvad dhi kurumukhyasya jīvatputrasya vai sukham babhūva tad avāpnotu bhogāṃś ceti vyavasthitāḥ
english: "Whatever happiness was the chief of the Kurus' when his sons were living, let him attain that and its enjoyments"—thus were they resolved.

sanskrit: tatas te sahitāḥ sarve bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ tathāśīlāḥ samātasthur dhṛtarāṣṭrasya śāsane
english: Then all the five Pāṇḍava brothers together, of such disposition, stood obedient to the rule of Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraś ca tān vīrān vinītān vinaye sthitān śiṣyavṛttau sthitān nityaṃ guruvat paryapaśyata
english: And Dhṛtarāṣṭra looked upon those heroes—well-disciplined, steadfast in good conduct, ever bearing themselves as pupils—as a teacher upon his own.

sanskrit: gāndhārī caiva putrāṇāṃ vividhaiḥ śrāddhakarmabhiḥ ānṛṇyam agamat kāmān viprebhyaḥ pratipādya vai
english: And Gāndhārī, through manifold funeral rites for her sons, discharged her debt to them, bestowing their desires upon the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit: evaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭho dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito dhīmān pūjayām āsa taṃ nṛpam
english: Thus the foremost of the upholders of dharma, the wise Dharma-king Yudhiṣṭhira, together with his brothers, did honor to that king.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca sa rājā sumahātejā vṛddhaḥ kurukulodvahaḥ nāpaśyata tadā kiṃ cid apriyaṃ pāṇḍunandane
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: That king of mighty splendor, the aged upholder of the Kuru line, saw then nothing displeasing in the son of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: vartamāneṣu sadvṛttiṃ pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu prītimān abhavad rājā dhṛtarāṣṭro 'mbikāsutaḥ
english: While the great-souled Pāṇḍavas held to good conduct, king Dhṛtarāṣṭra, son of Ambikā, grew full of contentment.

sanskrit: saubaleyī ca gāndhārī putraśokam apāsya tam sadaiva prītimaty āsīt tanayeṣu nijeṣv iva
english: And Gāndhārī, daughter of Subala, casting off her grief for her sons, was ever well-pleased with them, as with her own children.

sanskrit: priyāṇy eva tu kauravyo nāpriyāṇi kurūdvaha vaicitravīrye nṛpatau samācarati nityadā
english: Toward the king, son of Vicitravīrya, the Kaurava ever did only what was pleasing and nothing displeasing, O scion of the Kurus.

sanskrit: yad yad brūte ca kiṃ cit sa dhṛtarāṣṭro narādhipaḥ guru vā laghu vā kāryaṃ gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī
english: Whatever task, weighty or slight, that lord of men Dhṛtarāṣṭra would name, and the renowned Gāndhārī as well—

sanskrit: tat sa rājā mahārāja pāṇḍavānāṃ dhuraṃdharaḥ pūjayitvā vacas tat tad akārṣīt paravīrahā
english: that, O great king, the king, the foremost burden-bearer of the Pāṇḍavas, the slayer of hostile heroes, honored the word and carried out.

sanskrit: tena tasyābhavat prīto vṛttena sa narādhipaḥ anvatapyac ca saṃsmṛtya putraṃ mandam acetasam
english: With such conduct that lord of men was pleased with him, yet he grieved, remembering his dull and witless son.

sanskrit: sadā ca prātar utthāya kṛtajapyaḥ śucir nṛpaḥ āśāste pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ samareṣv aparājayam
english: And ever, rising at dawn, the king, having said his prayers and purified himself, would invoke for the sons of Pāṇḍu unconquerableness in battle.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇān vācayitvā ca hutvā caiva hutāśanam āyuṣyaṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇām āśāste sa narādhipaḥ
english: And having had the brāhmaṇas recite their blessings and having made oblation to the fire, that lord of men would invoke long life for the sons of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: na tāṃ prītiṃ parām āpa putrebhyaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ yāṃ prītiṃ pāṇḍuputrebhyaḥ samavāpa tadā nṛpaḥ
english: That lord of the earth had not attained from his own sons such supreme joy as the king then attained from the sons of Pāṇḍu.

sanskrit: brāhmaṇānāṃ ca vṛddhānāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca bhārata tathā viṭśūdrasaṃghānām abhavat supriyas tadā
english: And to the brāhmaṇas and the elders and the kṣatriyas, O Bhārata, and to the assembled vaiśyas and śūdras, he then became most dear.

sanskrit: yac ca kiṃ cit purā pāpaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasutaiḥ kṛtam akṛtvā hṛdi tad rājā taṃ nṛpaṃ so 'nvavartata
english: And whatever wrong had formerly been done by Dhṛtarāṣṭra's sons, the king, not keeping it in his heart, deferred to that king.

sanskrit: yaś ca kaś cin naraḥ kiṃ cid apriyaṃ cāmbikāsute kurute dveṣyatām eti sa kaunteyasya dhīmataḥ
english: And whatever man did anything displeasing to the son of Ambikā incurred the hatred of the wise son of Kuntī.

sanskrit: na rājño dhṛtarāṣṭrasya na ca duryodhanasya vai uvāca duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃ cid yudhiṣṭhirabhayān naraḥ
english: For fear of Yudhiṣṭhira no man would speak any ill deed of king Dhṛtarāṣṭra, nor indeed of Duryodhana.

sanskrit: dhṛtyā tuṣṭo narendrasya gāndhārī viduras tathā śaucena cājātaśatror na tu bhīmasya śatruhan
english: Pleased with the firmness of the king of men, and with his purity, were Gāndhārī and Vidura too—of him whose foe was never born; but not with Bhīma, O slayer of foes.

sanskrit: anvavartata bhīmo 'pi niṣṭanan dharmajaṃ nṛpam dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca saṃprekṣya sadā bhavati durmanāḥ
english: Bhīma too complied, though grumbling, with the king born of Dharma; yet looking upon Dhṛtarāṣṭra he was ever ill at heart.

sanskrit: rājānam anuvartantaṃ dharmaputraṃ mahāmatim anvavartata kauravyo hṛdayena parāṅmukhaḥ
english: That Kaurava complied with the great-minded son of Dharma, the king, who deferred to Dhṛtarāṣṭra—but with his heart turned away.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca yudhiṣṭhirasya nṛpater duryodhanapitus tathā nāntaraṃ dadṛśū rājan puruṣāḥ praṇayaṃ prati
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Between king Yudhiṣṭhira and the father of Duryodhana, O king, men saw no difference in regard to affection.

sanskrit: yadā tu kauravo rājā putraṃ sasmāra bāliśam tadā bhīmaṃ hṛdā rājann apadhyāti sa pārthivaḥ
english: But whenever the Kaurava king remembered his foolish son, then, O king, that lord brooded ill in his heart against Bhīma.

sanskrit: tathaiva bhīmaseno 'pi dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ janādhipam nāmarṣayata rājendra sadaivātuṣṭavad dhṛdā
english: And likewise Bhīmasena could not endure king Dhṛtarāṣṭra, O lord of kings, being ever as it were discontented in his heart.

sanskrit: aprakāśāny apriyāṇi cakārāsya vṛkodaraḥ ājñāṃ pratyaharac cāpi kṛtakaiḥ puruṣaiḥ sadā
english: In secret Vṛkodara did things displeasing to him, and ever, through suborned men, he would countermand his commands.

sanskrit: atha bhīmaḥ suhṛnmadhye bāhuśabdaṃ tathākarot saṃśrave dhṛtarāṣṭrasya gāndhāryāś cāpy amarṣaṇaḥ
english: Then Bhīma, the wrathful one, amid his friends would clap his arms within the hearing of Dhṛtarāṣṭra and of Gāndhārī as well.

sanskrit: smṛtvā duryodhanaṃ śatruṃ karṇaduḥśāsanāv api provācātha susaṃrabdho bhīmaḥ sa paruṣaṃ vacaḥ
english: Recalling his foe Duryodhana, and Karṇa and Duḥśāsana too, Bhīma, much enraged, then spoke these harsh words:

sanskrit: andhasya nṛpateḥ putrā mayā parighabāhunā nītā lokam amuṃ sarve nānāśastrāttajīvitāḥ
english: "The sons of the blind king were all sent by me, of the mace-like arms, to yonder world, their lives taken by sundry weapons."

sanskrit: imau tau parighaprakhyau bhujau mama durāsadau yayor antaram āsādya dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ kṣayaṃ gatāḥ
english: "These are those two arms of mine, like iron bludgeons, unassailable, coming within whose reach the sons of Dhṛtarāṣṭra went to their destruction."

sanskrit: tāv imau candanenāktau vandanīyau ca me bhujau yābhyāṃ duryodhano nītaḥ kṣayaṃ sasutabāndhavaḥ
english: "These two arms of mine, anointed with sandal and worthy of worship, by which Duryodhana was brought to ruin with his sons and kinsmen."

sanskrit: etāś cānyāś ca vividhāḥ śalyabhūtā janādhipaḥ vṛkodarasya tā vācaḥ śrutvā nirvedam āgamat
english: These and other manifold words of Vṛkodara, sharp as barbs, the lord of men heard, and was overcome with despair.

sanskrit: sā ca buddhimatī devī kālaparyāyavedinī gāndhārī sarvadharmajñā tāny alīkāni śuśruve
english: And that wise lady, who knew the turning of the times, Gāndhārī, versed in all dharma, heard those bitter taunts.

sanskrit: tataḥ pañcadaśe varṣe samatīte narādhipaḥ rājā nirvedam āpede bhīmavāgbāṇapīḍitaḥ
english: Then, when the fifteenth year had passed, the lord of men, the king, fell into despair, tormented by the arrows of Bhīma's speech.

sanskrit: nānvabudhyata tad rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śvetāśvo vātha kuntī vā draupadī vā yaśasvinī
english: Of this the king, Yudhiṣṭhira son of Kuntī, was unaware, nor was Arjuna of the white steeds, nor Kuntī, nor the renowned Draupadī.

sanskrit: mādrīputrau ca bhīmasya cittajñāv anvamodatām rājñas tu cittaṃ rakṣantau nocatuḥ kiṃ cid apriyam
english: But the two sons of Mādrī, who knew Bhīma's mind, gave their assent; yet, guarding the king's feelings, they uttered nothing displeasing.

sanskrit: tataḥ samānayām āsa dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ suhṛjjanam bāṣpasaṃdigdham atyartham idam āha vaco bhṛśam
english: Then Dhṛtarāṣṭra gathered together his friends, and choked exceedingly with tears, he spoke this word with great force:

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca viditaṃ bhavatām etad yathā vṛttaḥ kurukṣayaḥ mamāparādhāt tat sarvam iti jñeyaṃ tu kauravāḥ
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: It is known to you how the destruction of the Kurus came to pass; and all of it, O Kauravas, must be understood to have sprung from my fault.

sanskrit: yo 'haṃ duṣṭamatiṃ mūḍhaṃ jñātīnāṃ bhayavardhanam duryodhanaṃ kauravāṇām ādhipatye 'bhyaṣecayam
english: For it was I who consecrated to the sovereignty of the Kauravas that evil-minded, deluded Duryodhana, the increaser of his kinsmen's terror.

sanskrit: yac cāhaṃ vāsudevasya vākyaṃ nāśrauṣam arthavat vadhyatāṃ sādhv ayaṃ pāpaḥ sāmātya iti durmatiḥ
english: And in that I, dull of mind, did not heed the weighty word of Vāsudeva—"It is well that this sinner be slain along with his counsellors"—

sanskrit: putrasnehābhibhūtaś ca hitam ukto manīṣibhiḥ vidureṇātha bhīṣmeṇa droṇena ca kṛpeṇa ca
english: and that, overcome by love of my son, though counselled for my good by the wise—by Vidura, by Bhīṣma, by Droṇa, and by Kṛpa—

sanskrit: pade pade bhagavatā vyāsena ca mahātmanā saṃjayenātha gāndhāryā tad idaṃ tapyate 'dya mām
english: and at every step by the blessed great-souled Vyāsa, by Saṃjaya, and by Gāndhārī—for this it is that I am tormented today.

sanskrit: yac cāhaṃ pāṇḍuputreṇa guṇavatsu mahātmasu na dattavāñ śriyaṃ dīptāṃ pitṛpaitāmahīm imām
english: And in that I did not bestow upon the virtuous, great-souled sons of Pāṇḍu this blazing splendor, the heritage of fathers and forefathers—

sanskrit: vināśaṃ paśyamāno hi sarvarājñāṃ gadāgrajaḥ etac chreyaḥ sa paramam amanyata janārdanaḥ
english: for, foreseeing the destruction of all the kings, Janārdana the elder brother of Gada deemed this the supreme good.

sanskrit: so 'ham etāny alīkāni nivṛttāny ātmanaḥ sadā hṛdaye śalyabhūtāni dhārayāmi sahasraśaḥ
english: And so I bear within my heart, forever, these falsehoods that have rebounded upon myself, lodged there like a thousand barbs.

sanskrit: viśeṣatas tu dahyāmi varṣaṃ pañcadaśaṃ hi vai asya pāpasya śuddhyarthaṃ niyato 'smi sudurmatiḥ
english: And especially do I burn now in this fifteenth year; and for the purifying of this sin I, most ill-witted, hold myself under vows of restraint.

sanskrit: caturthe niyate kāle kadā cid api cāṣṭame tṛṣṇāvinayanaṃ bhuñje gāndhārī veda tan mama
english: At the appointed fourth watch, and sometimes only at the eighth, I take but what quells my thirst; Gāndhārī knows this of me.
